info.title: Road Runners API
info.summary: Versioned API contracts for Road Runners integrations, game clients and MCP.
info.description: Road Runners API v1 exposes public and authorized current-user read models plus a restricted asynchronous result-submission contract for timing companies. Every data endpoint requires Authorization Bearer; portal cookies are never accepted. Authenticated responses expose RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining and RateLimit-Reset.

get.description: Search current and future events. competition_id is an optional exact Foco Radical identifier, resolved through an active link to an active event. Existing date and search filters still apply. No match returns an empty list; the competition_id is not echoed in the response.

Search by a partial event name (q), full city name (city, case/accent insensitive) and state code (state), or filter by the exact Foco Radical competition_id. Existing date and result-availability filters still apply; no match returns an empty list. Each event includes stats.finishers and resultDistances for an event header when per-distance summaries exist. Participants can be requested using the same competition_id, without knowing a Road Runners identifier. The competition_id is not echoed in the response.

get.summary: Get public event detail by tag or id
get.description: Provide competition_id (Foco Radical), tag or id. An active Foco Radical link resolves the event without a Road Runners identifier or event name. No active link to an active event returns 404; there is no name or legacy-link fallback. competition_id cannot be combined with a Road Runners identifier and is not echoed in the response.

get.summary: List public official results for an event
get.description: Paginated finishers for one event. Provide competition_id (Foco Radical), tag or eventId. The same competition_id can be used for every page without knowing a Road Runners identifier. No active link to an active event returns 404. The result contains athlete, race and positions; pagination.total reflects the active filters. q matches part of the athlete name or an exact bib number. limit is capped at 100 and offset advances pages. Requires results:read_public. competition_id cannot be combined with a Road Runners identifier and is not echoed in the response.

Aggregated finishers and paces by distance, modality and gender. Provide competition_id (Foco Radical), tag or eventId. An active Foco Radical link resolves the event without a Road Runners identifier. No active link to an active event returns 404. Requires results:read_public. competition_id cannot be combined with a Road Runners identifier and is not echoed in the response.

post.summary: Submit a result source for asynchronous processing
post.description: Requires an operational token with results:submit. Both result URLs may use any valid HTTPS host; optional credential allowlists can be enabled later without changing the contract. The public URL is stored as a link, while the technical URL is fetched only by the asynchronous worker with SSRF protections. event_id and event_tag are optional hints.

BearerAuth.description: Integration or user Bearer token. Required for every data endpoint; never send tokens in query strings or cookies.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-generated identifier for one logical submission version. Persist it before the first attempt and reuse the same key with the exact same JSON after timeouts or lost responses. A retry returns the existing submission without duplication; reusing the key with different content returns 409. Use a new key for final publication or a later update. The key is scoped to clientId and is not a secret.

FocoCompetitionId.name: competition_id
FocoCompetitionId.description: Exact Foco Radical competition identifier. Optional alternative to Road Runners event identifiers; do not combine with id, eventId, event_id, id_evento, tag, eventTag or event_tag. Only active links to active events are used. Treat as a string and preserve leading zeros. Empty values, control characters or more than 255 characters return 400 invalid_competition_id; conflicting identifiers return 400 conflicting_event_identifiers. This input is not echoed in JSON responses.

ResultsEventIdOptional.name: eventId
ResultsEventIdOptional.description: Road Runners event id; alternative to tag and id.

EventNameQuery.name: q
EventNameQuery.description: Partial event name; the search also checks event tags and related text.

ResultParticipantQuery.name: q
ResultParticipantQuery.description: Part of the participant's name or an exact bib number.

RateLimitLimit.description: Maximum requests allowed in the current 60-second token window.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Requests remaining in the current token window.

RateLimitReset.description: Seconds until the current rate-limit window resets.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying after a 429 response.

ApiErrorCode.description: Stable machine-readable error code, equivalent to the status field in the JSON body.

EventRoutesDetail.description: Published routes linked to the selected event

RouteGeometry.description: Validated GeoJSON geometry for the current published route file

Unauthorized.description: Missing session or invalid Bearer credential

Forbidden.description: Insufficient scope or denied beta/private access

resultDistances.description: Published finishers by distance and modality; empty when no per-distance summary is available.

event_id.description: Optional Road Runners event ID hint. An unknown ID does not reject the submission.

event_tag.description: Optional Road Runners event tag hint. An unknown tag does not reject the submission.

external_event_id.description: Optional event identifier in the timing system.

external_account_id.description: Optional customer/account identifier inside the timing provider. Recommended when external event IDs are not globally unique.

url_resultado.description: HTTPS result source or provider route. URL fragments such as #/... are preserved for provider-specific adapters. It is queued without being fetched during the POST request.

url_resultado_publica.description: HTTPS official page where runners can view the result. It is stored as a link and is not fetched by the API.

open_results_enabled.description: Intent received from the timing provider. When omitted, it defaults to true. The processor still revalidates the current event.json before importing.

matched.description: Whether the submission is already linked to a Road Runners event.

open_results_enabled.description: Effective import intent persisted when the submission was received.
